text:
izzy: 2am couch poll: playlist for slowly dismantling a jigsaw puzzle (yes i start puzzles late). need ~50min, chill but slightly hopeful. any tiny anthems for the moment you click two edge pieces together? :puzzle_piece:

mike: edge-piece anthem = short swell. vote for something instrumental that builds quietly. Tycho or Nils Frahm.

tori: agree. add a couple of mellow indie upbeat tracks so you don't nap on the last 20 pieces.

izzy: ok seeds: Tycho opener, then a few Khruangbin grooves, finish with a brief triumphant pop snippet when i place the last piece.

playlist-bot: Suggested playlist: "Puzzle Late-Night: Calm & Small Wins"  11 tracks  https://open.spotify.com/playlist/puzzleLateNightExample

mike: pro tip: set a tiny 3-minute 'stretch' alarm for the midway slump. puzzle ergonomics matter.

tori: and take a photo of the final border for bragging rights. required evidence. :camera_with_flash:

izzy: queued playlist, alarm set, evidence protocol acknowledged. will report back with victory photo or confetti. :crossed_fingers:

(52 minutes later)

izzy: update: finished. one mystery piece in the couch, alarm saved me from an accidental nap, last-piece pop was perfect. playlist = staple. uploading photo to #random-photos now. :tada:
